title: Addition
summary: Addition combines counts by repeated successor.

context.note: This node belongs to one explicit foundational presentation; alternate foundations may encode it differently.

assumptions.text: The declared Peano-style arithmetic context is fixed.

content.plain: Addition combines counts by repeated successor.
content.exact: Recursively, add(a,0)=a and add(a,S(b))=S(add(a,b)). These equations define addition on a Peano natural-number structure.
content.caveat: Other number systems extend addition and must specify their construction and laws.
